Package eu.algites.lib.common.list

Class AIcBoundedList<T>

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<E>
java.util.AbstractList<T>
eu.algites.lib.common.list.AIcBoundedList<T>
Type Parameters:
T - element type
All Implemented Interfaces:
AIiValidatable<AIcdBoundedListValidationIssue>, Iterable<T>, Collection<T>, List<T>, RandomAccess
public class AIcBoundedList<T> extends AbstractList<T> implements RandomAccess, AIiValidatable<AIcdBoundedListValidationIssue>
Mutable list with nullable minimum and maximum cardinality constraints. A null bound means no constraint on that side. Minimum cardinality affects validity, not initial construction. Mutation policy applies to both bounds.

modifyAtomically(Consumer) validates the final size of a working copy and publishes the change only on successful completion. This provides all-or-nothing mutation semantics, not cross-thread synchronization. No callback should modify this list directly while modifying its working copy.

    • modifyAtomically

      public void modifyAtomically(Consumer<List<T>> aChange)
      Applies a series of mutations to a detached working list. The candidate is committed only if the callback succeeds and its final size satisfies the selected mutation policy relative to the initial list size. Intermediate candidate sizes are intentionally unrestricted.
